lesson_title: A Letter in an Old Boot
hook_text: The first post office in South Africa may have been an old shoe hanging in a tree.
clip_script: Mossel Bay, 1500. A Portuguese captain hangs a letter, wrapped in an old shoe, on a branch of a big milkwood tree. A year later, another ship's crew finds it and reads the news. Sailors start leaving letters under big stones at the Cape. Then come post offices, stamps, post runners, mail coaches, trains, mail ships and aeroplanes. Today, you can still post a letter beside that same old tree, in a post box shaped like a boot.
visual_style: Whiteboard drawing of a milkwood tree with a shoe hanging from a branch, then a stone with writing, a triangular stamp, a mail coach, a mail ship, an aeroplane and a post box.
mood: Charming and surprising, like finding a secret note.
pacing: Start under the tree, then race through the ways letters travelled, and end back at the tree.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write a short letter to someone you love.
